data.name: The Curse of Stuzhiy
data.detailed_description:
The Urals, late 2000s. A quiet posting in the mountain taiga ended the day the man watching the neighboring territory stopped answering the radio...

Ride Through the Silence

[pic]

Your snowmobile will take you along snowbound trails to places best not approached on foot.
As long as the fuel holds out...

Explore What Remains

[pic]

Abandoned winter cabins, rusted machinery and buildings that go all the way back to Soviet times.
These places remember a great deal...

Keep the Radio Close

[pic]

You're not alone as long as a familiar voice still answers on the air.
As long as the signal holds, not all is lost...

Dig for the Truth

[pic]

What's happening here is rooted in the old myths of this land.
People didn't believe in them for nothing...



And remember - the taiga forgives no mistakes! Your life is in your hands.

data.short_description: A short trip through the winter taiga to check on a comrade who's gone quiet turns into a story that should never have begun. Atmospheric first-person horror: explore the empty snowbound forest, follow the tracks, uncover the secrets these places keep. And yes - you're not alone out here...

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror elements (dark oppressive atmosphere, disturbing imagery, jump scares), attacks on the player character by supernatural creatures, player character death from creature attacks or exposure to extreme cold, depictions of death and human/animal remains (including frozen bodies and victims of hypothermia), old bloodstains at scenes of past tragic events, and strong language in dialogue. Characters may smoke and consume alcohol. There is no illegal drug use, sexual content, or nudity.
